description: INA 221(g). Government processing time for these cases is indefinite. Most resolve in months; some take years; some never resolve.
time_note: Reported range from months to over two years.

description: Applicants in technology, engineering and science fields are routed into Visas Mantis security checks. Iranian STEM applicants are among the most affected groups.
notes: Mantis exists to screen against the Technology Alert List.

aspect: No status, no escalation, no clock
description: State will not accept a status inquiry until 60 days after processing begins. Because it is framed as a national security matter, universities and members of Congress cannot influence speed or outcome, and once started it cannot be withdrawn.
energy_note: Total loss of agency: nothing the applicant does changes anything.

description: A writ of mandamus in US federal court can compel the consulate to act - not to approve. Legal fees are the cost of getting a decision at all.
notes: Fee band from immigration firm marketing; verify before citing.

description: Because the interview happened abroad, the passport is often held by the post. The applicant cannot travel onward or, sometimes, home, while the hold runs.
money_note: Extended stay abroad with no work rights.
notes: Recurrent in applicant forums; layer-5 target for specific accounts.

aspect: EXAMPLE - 45% of Iranian cases, 60-120 days added
description: One estimate puts 221(g) administrative processing as affecting roughly 45% of Iranian applicants and adding 60-120 days, against a median of about 210 days from DS-160 to issuance and interview waits of 60-180 days.
notes: Consultancy estimate, not State Department data.

aspect: EXAMPLE - choosing a post as strategy
description: Consultancies advise that post choice matters: Dubai officers are described as used to Iranian applicants with diversified business interests and substantial portfolios, while Ankara and Yerevan see fewer Iranian cases - more individual attention, less pattern recognition for borderline files.
energy_note: Gaming the geography of who judges you.

aspect: SCENARIO - fourteen months, then the job was gone
description: Omid's H-1B interview is in Dubai in March. Administrative processing begins. He may not enquire for 60 days. At month nine the employer asks whether he can start; at month eleven they withdraw the offer; at month fourteen the visa is issued. He now holds a valid work visa and no job to use it for.
energy_note: Approved, on the day it stopped mattering.
